title: The Last Baton: A Golden-Hour Relay Finish with MeshAsset Props
teaches: Model hero props (baton, runner caps, finish arch) purely from MeshAsset catmull-clark cages: swept 8-vertex rings, ngon end caps and pinned vertices that keep tips, brims and column joints crisp under subdivision.
Bind a prop to a running skeleton with Attachment/Socket: the baton snaps to hand_r and the caps snap to the head bone, so they inherit every stride without a second ApplyAction.
Sequence four external landing-page ActionLibrary files on one humanoid (run, walk stop, victory wave, catch-breath idle) as timed ApplyAction beats.
Keep foot IK and grounding exact while driving world travel with deterministic in-place locomotion plus position keyframes.
Cut a three-camera finish (side truck, arch wide, victory push-in) with discrete activeCamera keys and animate bloom through the tape break.
Grade a golden-hour stadium with ACES at 5200K, warm exponential haze, emissive floodlight panels and seeded confetti volume repeats.
